title: JournalEntry
description: Undo records kept for one committed batch of a journaled cause.

undo.description: In application order; invert in reverse.

ActivityScope.description: Where an activity tally is kept.

ActivityTally.description: Running activity at a station or region. Integers, so undo is exact.

pending_milli.description: Pulses counted but not yet applied to the market (thousandths).

pulses_milli.description: Pulses so far, in thousandths of a pulse.

BuildState.description: A station's visible growth: a stage number plus the kit parts attached.

Command.description:
One world change. Add a variant here, its apply/undo arm in `galaxy_core::apply`,
and regenerate the schemas (`cargo xtask contract`).

oneOf.description:
Changes nothing, and fails unless `ship` is docked at `station`. A batch that
only makes sense at a dock (a trade) carries one, so a ship that undocked
earlier in the same tick rejects it. Its inverse is itself.
Adds (positive) or removes (negative) cargo. Fails below zero.
Adds to the player's credits, in centicredits. Fails below zero.
Changes a rock's remaining units. Fails below zero.
Sets or removes (`None`) one ware's line at a station's market.

Replaces a market line only if it still equals `from`, so trades and pulses
worked out from the same tick's state can't overwrite each other: a stale one
fails and its batch is rejected. The economy's trades and pulses use this.

Sets a line's producer and consumer rates (market levers), leaving its stock,
saturation and prices alone.
Adds to a station's or region's activity tally (pulses, trade volume).
Sets or clears (`None`) where a ship last docked, for the counted-docking rule.
Emits an event on commit; the engine records its fact and bumps counters.
Appends a fact of a pack's own kind on commit.

Condition.description: A world condition. Evaluated by the engine against world state only.

CounterKind.description: Activity counters. Pacing reads these, never a clock.

oneOf.description: Sales and deliveries, one per transaction.

DockTrack.description: A ship's last docking, for the counted-docking rule.

away.description: It has since gone far enough or mined, so docking here again counts.

Event.description: Something that happened, with stable IDs.

oneOf.description: Units moved from a rock into a hold.

unit_price.description: The average unit price, in centicredits.
The average unit price, in centicredits.

oneOf.description: Cargo handed over for a goal or a station's growth, not sold.
A price snapshot was taken at a station.
A play session began (the app emits it when the game starts).

FactDraft.description: A fact to record, before the engine assigns its ID, tick and cause.

standing.description: The player's standing. Shown through how people treat you, not a bar.

oneOf.description: Travel to another region along lanes.

Hull.description: A hull class. Provisional numbers live in the core pack's `hulls.toml`.

max_speed.description: World units per second at nominal tick rate.

mining_rate.description: Mining units per second at nominal tick rate.

price_reach.description: How far the hull sees live market prices. Default: docked only.

Lane.description: A lane between two regions. Gates are world positions at each end.

Market.description: A station market as plain data. W3 (economy) owns the maths that moves it.

MarketLine.description:
One ware at one market. W3 (`galaxy-economy`) prices it; see
[`PricingRules`](crate::economy::PricingRules) for the formula.

base_price.description: Where the price settles with no pressure.

consumption.description: Units the station uses per station pulse.

needs.description: Production runs only while each of these wares is in stock here.

price.description:
The current unit price in centicredits: what the station pays for a `buys`
line, what it asks for a `sells` line. Kept up to date by the economy. Every
price here is in centicredits ([`crate::money`]).

production.description: Units the station makes per station pulse (activity, never a clock).

sat_per_unit.description: Saturation added per unit sold to the station.

saturation.description: 0 (fresh) up to the rules' `saturation_max`. Only `buys` lines saturate.

stock_carry.description: The fraction of a unit produced or used but not yet whole, in 0..1.

target.description:
The stock the station aims for; prices rise below it and fall above it. Zero:
stock doesn't move the price.

MarketRates.description:
The producer and consumer rates of one market line, per station pulse. Levers
change these without touching stock, saturation or the price formula.

MarketRole.description:
Whether a station buys a ware from ships or sells it to them. A station never
buys a ware it produces, or sells one it consumes.

oneOf.description: The station buys it (pays a price that saturation lowers).
The station sells it (asks a price with a spread).
Mine until the hold is full or the rock is depleted.
Wait until a world condition holds (e.g. a price recovers above a floor).
Repeat `orders` until `until` holds, or forever.

OrderQueue.description: A ship's orders and where it is in them. W2 may add progress fields.

current.description: Index of the order being executed.

Owner.description:
Who owns a ship. Player-owned ships (flagship and automated craft) feed the
player's activity counters.

PriceReach.description: How far a hull sees live prices. The default is "docked only".

lane_scout.description: A lane arrival refreshes the snapshots of every station in the new region.

radius.description: Live prices of stations within this distance. Zero: docked only.

region.description: Live prices of every station in the ship's region.

PriceSnapshot.description: What the player saw at a station's market on their last visit.

visit.description: The player's docking count when it was taken: "dated by your last visit".

oneOf.description: Everything in the hold (sell) or everything affordable that fits (buy).

initial.description: Units when generated; `remaining / initial` drives the visible shrink.

RockField.description:
An authored field. Rocks are generated from it once, at new game, with stable IDs
`<rock_prefix>.01`, `<rock_prefix>.02`, ...

rock_prefix.description: Prefix for generated rock IDs, e.g. `rock.shallows.ice`.

hardness.description: Multiplier on a hull's mining rate (1.0 = normal, higher = slower).

regrowth.description: Units regrown per regrowth step (W2 defines the step from activity, never a clock).

Rumor.description: A rumor with a truth value. It may be true, or planted.

claim.description: What it claims, in one line.

planted_by.description: Who planted it, if it's a plant.

source.description: The fact it grew from, if any.

Service.description: What a station offers when docked.

orders.description: The ship's order queue (same verbs for player, automated and NPC craft).

dock_radius.description: Ships within this distance of `position` can dock.

Subjects.description:
The indexed subjects of a fact. Every field is optional; queries match on any
combination. Add a field here (and a column in the save's `history` table) to
index a new kind of subject.

other.description: Any other entity (a quest, trait, hull, lane, rumor ...).

Tick.description: Simulation tick count (30 per second nominal; the sim never reads a clock).

UndoRecord.description: What it takes to undo one applied command.

oneOf.description: Apply this command to restore the previous state.
Can't be undone exactly; a rollback must compensate in-world.

Vec2.description: A point or vector on the sim plane.

VerbKind.description: Verb names, used in causes and `order_done` events.

tradeable.description: False for things that can't be bought or sold (the Ancients fragment).
